openQuestions.question: Does boarding a tram or sky rail have a price, and if so what is it made of (wait, ride, anything else)?
openQuestions.why: The brief and source passages leave pricing to Motive. Pulse supplies only headways, dwells and run times and invents no cost.

openQuestions.question: Do the starting headways (T1/T2 180 s, S1 120 s) and dwells (trams 15 s, sky rail 20 s) stand?
openQuestions.why: The GDD gives none. They are Pulse's starting values, to be tuned by playtest.

openQuestions.question: Does the walk between linked stops (T1/circus to S1/circus, T1/records to T2/market) count toward a journey's time?
openQuestions.why: Interchange walking is not in the timetable, so no cross-line journeys are listed.

openQuestions.question: Do services run for the whole mission clock, and does boarding carry any cost or limit beyond the timetable?
openQuestions.why: Operating hours and any extra cost are undecided; none is invented.

openQuestions.question: Should S1 Skyport be a timetabled station, and should T1/T2 extend past the sheet?
openQuestions.why: The plan text lists Skyport (530,0), but the candidate stations and chainage list omit it, so it is untimetabled. Termini are off-sheet.

notes: Speeds [S], starting values: trams 6 m/s (about 22 km/h); sky rail 8 m/s (about 29 km/h). Run sec = chainage gap / speed, rounded to whole seconds (half up), acceleration and braking folded in.
Journey sec = ride plus dwell at each intermediate stop. It excludes the wait for the first service, which runs from 0 to one headway: T1/T2 up to 180 s, S1 up to 120 s.
Lines are double track, so run times are the same both ways and reverse journeys have the same sec. All listed journeys are single-line, so via is empty.
T2 market to harbour-court: the listed gap is 327 m, but chainages 1108 minus 782 give 326 m. I used 326 m, so 54 s. Please confirm which figure is right.

S1/skyport and the skyport loop are left out: the stop list has no Skyport chainage and unknown stops are rejected. S1 harbour sits at x 332 in the stop list but 340 in the plan notes, which Datum should reconcile.
